## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a notably meek individual. Within his community, he is commonly identified primarily as [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde was married to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). When his wife attended a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) alongside [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), he remained at home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_
